description: This file defines functions and configuration for setting up and managing an IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel (6in4) in a network environment, including setup, update, and teardown procedures, as well as configuration initialization.

methods.name: proto_6in4_setup
methods.description: Configures and initiates the IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel based on provided parameters.
